title: sonchus oleraceus subsp. asper
intro: Sonchus oleraceus subsp. asper, commonly known as the prickly sow thistle, is a subspecies of the Sonchus oleraceus plant, which is a type of thistle that is native to Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its edible leaves and roots, which have been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The bioactive constituents of Sonchus oleraceus subsp. asper include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of this plant include reducing oxidative stress, improving gut health, and exhibiting potential anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
